summary: Compact Noether R121 Paper 12 no-duplicate audit. It verifies that known P12 RA48/RA59/R94 changes are already visible in R121, so those patches should not be replayed onto the current cumulative.
verification_summary: R121 contains the visible numbered P12 title and source author line.
R121 contains the source-exact initial definition f(x;dx).
R121 contains d^2x,d\delta x at known higher-differential loci and no d^2x,ddx occurrence.
R121 contains the P12 barred-delta convention where RA59/R94 required it, while retaining plain delta x at formula (9).
R121 uses source-style srcnumdisplay (1) through (14) for numbered displays.
R121 retains the final Math. Annalen publication sentence.
limitations: No new TeX patch is included.
No reader PDF, source images, or translations are included in this compact package.
This package is not fresh page-by-page recertification; it verifies survival of RA59/R94 P12 closure anchors in R121.
RA59 ledger reports all eight P12 source pages were opened from full-resolution GDZ/IIIF JPEGs, but that evidence is prior-ledger provenance here.
Not whole-corpus certification and not a critical edition.
recommended_next_action: Use as a compact skip/anti-duplication guardrail for active Noether web work. Upload only as coordination/provenance evidence if useful; do not present it as new reader output.
github_note: Corrections and source comparisons can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
